Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back! The English players are on the ground. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India Women. Lauren Bell to bowl the opening over. All set. Here we go again...
... CHASE TIME ...
Right then, 162 is a par score at this venue and India Women have done well to restrict England Women below that. Can the visitors now chase it down to level the series? Let's wait and watch.

As expected, India Women turned up with full force after the disappointment of the last game. They picked up three wickets in the Powerplay and had England Women on the mat at the halfway mark. However, they failed to maintain the same intensity when the partnership between Maia Bouchier and Freya Kemp developed. The Indian bowlers bowled too many 'slot deliveries' and that helped England Women to get a few easy boundaries. The pick of the bowler has to be Sneh Rana and the others also rallied around her decently. Another thing worth mentioning is India's fielding. It was electric, to say the least, and they were proving a point. A couple of catches did go down but overall the energy on the field was excellent.

Good recovery from England Women to post a challenging total on the board. They were five down in the 10th over and were tottering at 54 for 5 when the pair of Maia Bouchier and Freya Kemp emerged with a rescue act. Kemp, the superstar in the making, brought a fresh lease of life for the home team and stole the momentum away from India Women with her positive approach. She smashed a 37-ball 51, her maiden fifty and became the youngest to do so for England Women. Freya's partnership with Maia set the platform and the hosts finished with 142 runs on the board.
A dot to end the innings! Shorter ball, wide of off. Freya Kemp looks to cut this one away but she misses. England Women end at 142 for 6!

FOUR! A six followed by a four! Another top shot and she brings up her maiden half ton in style. What a knock this has been from her! She has guided England to a healthy total. Coming to the ball - Another fuller ball, around off, slower through the air. Freya Kemp dances down the pitch and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary this time.
SIX! BANG! She gets hold of this one! A loopy ball, full, around middle. Freya Kemp shimmies down the pitch and tonks it straight down the ground all the way for a biggie.
A fuller ball again, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone heaves this one across the line and towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Radha Yadav comes 'round the wicket now, she serves a fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it back to the bowler. Freya looks for a run but is sent back and Radha misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Fuller ball, outside off. Freya Kemp steps down and strokes this one towards long off for a run.
Radha Yadav to bowl the last over.
FOUR! Top shot! Pooja Vastrakar misses her yorker and she serves a fuller ball in the slot, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone heaves this one over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, another fuller ball. Freya Kemp slices this one towards deep point. Only a single this time.
Freya Kemp takes the aerial route now, but the ball lands safely! A fuller one, around off. Freya Kemp shuffles across and lifts it over mid-wicket. Two taken.
Fuller ball, wide of off. Freya Kemp stays in her crease and looks to cut this one away but she fails to reach the ball.
A touch short and on middle, Sophie goes back and helps it to square leg for a run.
Too full in length and wide outside off, Kemp reaches out and pushes it off the bottom edge to covers. They cross.
Pooja Vastrakar is back into the attack.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it towards covers off the back foot. End of an excellent spell from Sneh Rana - 3 for 24 in her 4 overs.
Wide of off this time, fullish ball. Freya Kemp pushes it towards long off and takes a run.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone arrives. She strikes at 124.8 in T20Is. Perfect batter to have at this stage.

OUT! STUMPED! Sneh Rana finally breaks this stand! She grabs her third wicket of the game and England Women have now lost their sixth. A lovely ball from Sneh Rana! Slower through the air, full, outside off, spinning away a tad. Maia Bouchier takes a big stride forward, gets down on her knee and looks to sweep this one. But she misses. Richa Ghosh collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. The square leg umpire says it's out straight away and Maia Bouchier has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: A loopy ball again, outside off, pitches it up. Freya Kemp once again steps down and knocks it towards long off for a single.
A fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Freya Kemp dances down the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler.
Sneh Rana to bowl her last over. 2 for 21 so far.
Tosses this one up, she serves it full, outside off. Freya Kemp shuffles across, leans forward, and drives it down to long off for a run. She retains the strike!
Good running! Width on offer now, short in length. Freya Kemp cuts this one towards sweeper cover and comes back quickly for the second run.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Maia Bouchier advances down the pitch and works it away towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Aerial but in the gap! This is now Maia Bouchier's best T20I score. Short in length and outside off, Maia goes back and whacks it over backward point for a boundary.
Fires it full again, wide outside off, Freya reaches out and forces it to extra cover where the fielder makes a half stop. They cross.
Full and outside off, Kemp walks forward and pushes it to extra cover.
Deepti Sharma is back on. 1 for 12 in her 3 overs so far.
Fuller now, down the leg side. Maia Bouchier gets low and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Maia Bouchier cuts it towards the fielder at point. Two dots in a row now.
Slower through the air, full toss, around midde. Maia Bouchier steps down and swipes this one towards mid-wicket. No run there!

Put down! Tad fuller now, around middle. Maia Bouchier heaves it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there, Kiran Navgire, leaps and gets her hands to the ball, but she fails to hold on to the catch. Another two.

Another short ball now, around middle. Maia Bouchier pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there does well to keep the ball away from the boundary ropes. Two taken. The 50-run stand comes up!
A shorter ball, spinning away a tad, around off. Maia Bouchier rocks back and pushes it towards cover.
BEATEN! This is fuller in length and outside off, angling away, Freya Kemp slashes at it but misses.
This is in the blockhole and on off, Freya Kemp squeezes it towards covers.
Pooja Vastrakar continues bowling full, on middle this time, Maia Bouchier drives it down to long on for another run.
Full again and outside off, Freya Kemp mistimes her lofted drive towards long off for just a single.
WIDE! This is full but way outside off, Freya Kemp uses her feet and tries to reach it but misses. Wided.
This is almost on a yorker length, on off, Maia Bouchier digs it towards long off for a run. With that, the 100 is up for England Women.
A low full toss and around off, Freya Kemp forces it down to long off for a single.
Pooja Vastrakar is brought back into the attack. 17 runs in her two overs so far.
Shortish and around off, Freya Kemp goes on her back foot and punches it towards cover where the fielder lets it through. A single is taken.

KEMP IS SAFE! Short in length and outside off, Kemp gets back and tries to cut but misses. Richa Ghosh collects the ball, waits quietly and as soon as Freya lifts her back leg, the keeper takes the bails off and appeals. The third umpire is referred to. First, the outside edge is checked which is absent and then the side-on angle finds Kemp safe. The replays show that more than lifting the back leg, Freya Kemp dragged it inside the crease.
Stumping chance! A loud appeal from Richa Ghosh as she whips the bails off.
A bit short, on middle and leg, Maia Bouchier goes back and tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss outside off, Freya Kemp reaches for it and plays it off the toe end towards cover for another run.
Nicely tossed up, full and on middle, Maia Bouchier skips down the track and eases it towards long on for a single.
Floated, short and outside off, Freya Kemp cuts it off her back foot towards deep point for a single.
Sneh Rana (2-0-16-2) is back on!
Another full delivery, outside off, Freya Kemp forces it down to long off for a run. 13 runs from the over then.
WIDE! Singh loses her line and fires a full ball, way outside off. Wided.
On a length and outside off, Freya Kemp stays there and pushes it towards extra cover.

FOUR! Drilled down the track, Freya Kemp is delivering a counter punch here. Renuka Singh goes fuller and straighter this time, Kemp forces it straight down the ground and finds the fence. England Women are recovering well!
SIX! Up and over the fence! Freya Kemp is impressing here! Slower one from Singh, on a length and around off, Freya picks it early and deposits it over cow corner for a maximum.

This is on a length and around off, Freya Kemp comes down the track and slaps it towards extra cover where the fielder dives to her right to make the stop. India Women are putting their all on the field.
Fuller one and on middle, Maia Bouchier chips it towards long on for a run.
Renuka Singh (3-0-17-1) comes back to bowl. She replaces Pooja Vastrakar.
Good fielding! This is looped up, full and on leg, Freya Kemp makes room and drills it towards mid-wicket where the fielder dives to to stop it. A dot!
Shorter in length and on off this time, Freya Kemp makes room and punches it off her back foot towards covers.
Short and on middle, Freya Kemp pulls it but straight to mid-wicket.

SIX! Dismissed! Flighted and full, landing outside off, Freya Kemp advances down the track and pumps it down towards long on. The fielder there is standing a few steps ahead of the fence, tries to jump and catch it over her head but the ball sails over.
Tossed up, full and down the leg side, Maia Bouchier goes down and sweeps it towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Freya Kemp uses her feet and lofts it towards long off for a single.
Change of ends for Radha Yadav. She went for 10 runs in her first over.

Maia Bouchier skips down the track and takes this on the full to tuck it wide of the deep square leg fielder. The fielder there does well to cover the ground and dives to her right to stop it. Two runs are taken. 12 from the over!
FOUR! Maia Bouchier is showing her class! She picks the slower one very early, fetches a full ball from outside off and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
This is on a good length and on middle, shaping away a bit, Freya Kemp mistimes her pull shot towards short fine leg for a brisk run.
A slower one now, full and outside off, Maia Bouchier stays there and drills it through cover-point for a single.
This is a bit fuller, on off, Maia Bouchier takes a couple of steps down the pitch and drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Good timing! Back of a length and outside off, Maia Bouchier stays back and crunches it through extra cover for a lovely boundary.
Slower now, shorter as well, outside off. Freya Kemp cuts it through point for a brace. At the halfway mark, England Women are 60 for 5.
FOUR! Freya Kemp is off the mark in style! A loopy ball, full, around middle and leg. Freya Kemp dances down the pitch and lifts this one over mid on for a boundary.
Slower through the air, fuller in length, around middle. Freya Kemp pushes it back to the bowler.
Freya Kemp is the new batter.

OUT! TIMBER! Two wickets in two overs for Sneh Rana and England Women are in all sorts of trouble. They have lost half their side now. Loopy ball, a tad quicker, very full, around middle. Amy Jones gets low and tries to reverse sweep this one but she misses it. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. A big blow to England Women as their skipper walks back now.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Maia Bouchier dances down the pitch and knocks it towards long off for a single.
Tosses it up, darting it on the pads, fullish ball. Maia Bouchier works it away towards short fine leg. No run there!
Fuller and angling in around off, Amy drives it firmly but finds mid on.
On a good length around off, hit towards the cover fielder.
Short in length and wide outside off, Maia cuts it through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! Fullish and outside off, Maia Bouchier walks down the track and unfurls a lovely straight drive. It beats the diving mid on fielder and races away to the fence.
Pitches it up now, around middle and off. Maia Bouchier drives this one towards the fielder at mid on.
On a length now, around middle and off. Maia Bouchier looks to push this away on the off side but she gets an inside edge back onto her pads and the ball rolls to square leg.
Change in bowling. Pooja Vastrakar is introduced into the attack. One slip in place.
Loopy ball, full, darting it on the pads. Amy Jones looks to sweep this one but she misses and gets hit on her pads.
Maia Bouchier is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! A stunning catch from Radha Yadav and Pooja Vastrakar can breathe a sigh of relief. Sneh Rana strikes in her first over. Tosses this one up, fuller in length, around middle. Bryony Smith looks to go downtown but miscues her shot in front of long on. Radha Yadav runs forward to her left, dives and takes a terrific catch to dismiss Bryony Smith. England Women are 4 down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED AND FOUR! Oh, dear! How costly will that prove to be? A short ball, around middle. Bryony Smith pulls this one straight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Pooja Vastrakar runs forward to catch the ball, but the ball goes through her hands and towards the boundary ropes for four runs.
Fuller ball, around middle. Amy Jones eases this one towards long on for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Another short ball, outside off. Amy Jones stays in his crease and slaps this one through cover. The fielder there fails to stop that one and it rolls away towards deep cover for a boundary.
Sneh Rana begins with a short ball, around middle. Amy Jones hangs back and blocks it out.
Sneh Rana is into the attack also.
Back of a length now, around middle and off. Amy Jones rocks back and punches it through cover for a single.
Fuller one, around middle. Amy Jones pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Smart batting by Amy Jones! A fuller ball, slower through the air, full and around off. Amy Jones gets down on her knee and reverse-sweeps this one past short third man for another boundary in the over.
Good stop! A fuller one, around middle and leg. Amy Jones steps down the pitch and drives it towards cover. The fielder there dives to her right and makes a good stop.
Tosses it up now, full in length, around middle. Bryony Smith lifts this one over the bowler's head towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Oh, fine shot! A shorter ball, around middle and leg. Bryony Smith uses the depth of her crease and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Radha Yadav comes into the attack now.
Shortish and on off, punched back to the bowler. End of an excellent Powerplay for India Women. They have England Women struggling at 29 for 3.
Flatter and outside off, it's forced towards covers where Harmanpreet Kaur dives and takes the pace off the ball. The batters cross.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up, full and around off, Jones jumps down the track to heave it over the leg side but gets it away off the inner edge. It flies down to wide mid on and they cross.
Edgy! Flighted and full, around off, Jones decides to sweep but gets a top edge. It balloons behind the keeper and the first slip fielder gives the chase. They cross for a couple of runs.
Finds the fielder, again. A bit short outside off, Amy punches it to short cover.
A touch short and on off, Jones goes on the back foot and hits it to cover-point.
On a length and around off, Bryony pushes it without much timing to short cover.
Bowls it short again, outside off, Jones gets close to the delivery and steers it through cover-point for a run.
Identical to the last delivery, Smith punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Short and wide outside off, Smith slaps it to sweeper cover where Radha dives to make a superb stop. The batters take two.
Pitches it up and around off, Smith hangs on the back foot this time and defends it back.
Back of a length, around off and angling in, Jones hangs on the back foot and hits it through wide mid on for a single.
Loopy and full, on middle, Jones hits it a but aerially but safely down to long on for a single.
Very full and on off, flicked past the mid-wicket fielder for one.
Floated and full around off, pushed to covers.
Flatter and on off, punched to covers.
Fuller around middle, worked to square leg for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Skipper Amy Jones walks in next with England Women in a spot of bother.

OUT! RUN OUT! Things are going from bad to worse for England Women. Complete miscommunication. Width outside off, short in length, Alice Capsey slaps it through covers and Radha Yadav gives the chase. She puts in a dive to pull it back in the deep and then throws it to the cover fielder, Harmanpreet Kaur. Meanwhile, Alice Capsey turns for the third run and keeps on running despite Bryony Smith showing no interest. Alice is halfway down the track, stranded as the throw is fired to the keeper. Richa Ghosh fumbles at first but then recovers to take the bails off. A huge setback for England Women.
Play and a miss! Width there outside off, Alice Capsey throws her bat at it but fails to connect.
Short again, outside off, Capsey cuts but finds backward point.
Short and outside off, forced through covers for a single.
Angling down the leg side, Smith helps it off her pads to square leg.
Bryony Smith is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant bowling from Renuka Singh. She angles in a length ball around off, Danni Wyatt doesn't take her front foot forward much and tries to defend thinking it to be an inswinger. But the ball lands and holds its line to take the outside edge. Sneh Rana takes a good reaction catch at first slip, going down to her left. India Women are off to a superb start!
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide outside off, this time Danni chops her attempted square cut and it goes through cover-point. They cross. A good over for India Women this time.
Slightly short on off, Capsey moves back and tickles it in front of square on the leg side for one more.
Sharma drags her length short and delivers it outside off, Wyatt goes back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A bit short and on off, Alice goes on the back foot and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and fuller around off, defended to the off side.
Alice Capsey is in next.

OUT! STUMPED! Floated delivery, full and outside off and spinning in, Dunkley gives the premeditated charge as she aims to slog it over the leg side. Misses completely and Richa Ghosh does a smooth job behind the stumps. The square leg umpire lifts the finger and the star of the last match walks.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma to bowl from the other end. Slip in place...
Inswinger, on a length around off, Danni defends it to the off side. A good start for England Women.

FOUR! Nicely timed and placed! Short in length and outside off, Wyatt goes on the back foot and steers it through the gap between backward point and short third man. The fielder dives inside the ring but in vain. Danni Wyatt is also off the mark with a boundary.
Slightly short and on middle, Dunkley taps it down in front of square on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Fine shot! Fuller in length, around middle and moving in, Sophia Dunkley flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket and finds the boundary to open her account.

Brilliant start from Renuka. Delivers this one on a length outside off and gets it to straighten off the seam, Dunkley walks forward as she pushes inside the line and misses. Richa Ghosh collects and knocks the stumps down at her end but Sophia Dunkley is safely in.
The keeper comes up.
Renuka begins with a big inswinger. Landing on a good length outside off, shaping in, Sophia Dunkley makes a close leave after reading the delivery.

It's time to get going now! The India Women players get into a customary huddle before spreading on the ground. Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt are the English openers. Renuka Singh is ready to bowl the first over. One slip waiting in Deepti Sharma. Here we go...

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Dayalan Hemalatha, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Kiran Navgire, Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Sneh Rana, Radha Yadav and Renuka Singh.

England Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Amy Jones (C/WK), Maia Bouchier, Bryony Smith, Sophie Ecclestone, Freya Kemp, Sarah Glenn, Freya Davies and Lauren Bell.
Toss - It's time to flip the coin. Harmanpreet Kaur calls incorrectly and England Women elect to bat first!
